blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Sibol’s Mobile Legends: Bang Bang squad begins its Asian Games 2026 esports campaign Tuesday with a clear goal: win gold for Team Philippines. The Philippines opens its Group C competition against Jordan at 2 p.m. before facing Kazakhstan at 5 p.m. at Aichi Sky Expo.
